meta.heading: PROJECTS
meta.subheading: Ideas turned into real, working systems — from robots to visual productions.

projects.title: Robowar
projects.description: An 8 kg combat robot designed in SolidWorks with an Al 6082 body, H13 steel weapon, and S24 steel shaft. High-stress parts achieved 48-51 HRC through oil quenching.

projects.title: RC Car
projects.description: Features a laser-cut, bent steel plate chassis designed in CAD with rubber-gripped wheels for traction. Optimized by replacing Arduino/motor controllers with an ESC to improve response time.

projects.title: Sumo Bot
projects.description: A robust combat bot focusing on strength, stability, and pushing power.

projects.title: Tug of War Bot
projects.description: High-torque bot optimized for maximum traction and mechanical endurance under heavy load.

projects.title: Soccer Bot
projects.description: Manually controlled bot designed for high speed and responsiveness.

projects.title: RC Plane
projects.description: A training model designed for durability and ease of handling to help club members practice flight control foundations.

projects.title: Pick and Place Bot
projects.description: Focused on robotic arm coordination and precision handling in dynamic environments.

projects.title: Maze Solver
projects.description: Advanced from ultrasonic sensors to a LiDAR-based system with custom PCBs.

projects.title: Line Follower
projects.description: Upgraded from a 5-sensor to an 8-sensor system with custom PCBs.

projects.title: Hexapod
projects.description: Six-legged robot engineered for navigation over uneven terrain.

projects.title: Custom Flight Drone
projects.description: Development of a custom flight controller using Arduino Uno and MPU6050[cite: 132, 133]. Successfully implemented angle hold and currently integrating barometer-based stable mode[cite: 133, 134].

projects.title: Python Workshop
projects.description: A Python workshop was conducted for the students of the Robotics Club to introduce them to coding, assist in programming robots, and help them gain hands-on experience in coding for robotics applications.

projects.title: Design Workshop
projects.description: A SolidWorks design workshop was conducted for students to enhance their skills in designing various types of robots. The workshop focused on both 2D and 3D design, providing hands-on experience in creating detailed and precise models. It aimed to help students develop essential design skills for building and prototyping robots effectively.

projects.title: Hardware workshop
projects.description: A hardware workshop was conducted to help students understand the selection of materials and components for building robots. The session focused on choosing the right parts for efficient design and functionality, enhancing their practical knowledge in robotics hardware and providing basic knowledge of power transmission.
